reveal_en: Ancient Tyrian purple, the color of emperors and kings, was extracted from thousands of Murex sea snails. Producing just one gram required around 9,000 snails, making it more valuable than gold by weight.
reveal_zh: 古代帝王專屬的泰爾紫，需從數千隻骨螺中提取。生產一克染料約需9000隻海螺，因此其價值曾一度超越等重黃金。
meaning_en: This color wasn't just aesthetic; it was a potent symbol of power and wealth, reflecting a society's resource-intensive pursuit of status.
meaning_zh: 這種顏色不僅是美學，更是權力與財富的強大象徵，映照出社會對地位的資源密集型追求。

visual.motion: Subtle swirling patterns reminiscent of ancient textiles or deep ocean currents.
